summary: subelements parameters: required list, required subelement name, and skip_missing (default false) to ignore items without the subelement.
questions: How do I stop subelements failing when some items lack the key?

answer_card.title: subelements parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (list, required): original list
- `_subelement` (str, required): property to extract from each item
- `skip_missing` (default false): if true, ignore items missing the subelement instead of erroring
